title: Solving Equations
author: 67c35bc096ac61519e36f740
chapter_outcomes: Solve equations of the type |ax + b| = c (c ⩾ 0), |ax + b| = cx + d, |ax + b| = |cx + d|, |ax² + bx + c| = d using algebraic or graphical methods.
Solve graphically or algebraically inequalities of the type k|ax + b| > c (c ⩾ 0), k|ax + b| ⩽ c (c > 0), k|ax + b| ⩽ |cx + d| where k > 0, |ax + b| ⩽ cx + d, |ax² + bx + c| > d, |ax² + bx + c| ⩽ d
Use substitution to form and solve a quadratic equation in order to solve a related equation.
Sketch the graphs of cubic polynomials and their moduli, when given as a product of three linear factors.
Solve graphically cubic inequalities of the form f(x) ⩾ d, f(x) > d, f(x) ⩽ d, f(x) < d where f(x) is a product of three linear factors and d is a constant.
